verdict.rationale: Smithery proxies tool calls through its REST interface and scopes tokens to list and call tools, so an audit log of tool calls is a fair question for this gateway. However, nothing in the evidence documents call logging, audit trails, or replay. Proxying calls and scoping tokens are adjacent features, not a log of what an agent did.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
